name: read_volume_charge1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
L=Path.cwd()
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources/volume.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
for n,s in [('sources/volume.txt',r.stdout),('plans/search1.json',json.dumps({'queries':['"volume triangle" "diagonal" polytope recurrence','"cyclic ordering" matroid bases conjecture solved','"exact matching" bipartite deterministic algorithm 2026']}))]:
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(r.stdout)
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'charge_search.py'),str(L/'plans/search1.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(z.stdout,z.stderr);assert z.returncode==0
